records.title: LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning via a Latent-Space Unified Model
records.reason: arXiv abstract: unified latent-space model targets cross-modal video/audio understanding and generation quality; no inference resource improvement is reported.

records.title: TokenDance: Token-to-Token Music-to-Dance Generation with Bidirectional Mamba
records.reason: arXiv abstract: Bidirectional Mamba gives efficient non-autoregressive music-to-dance generation; this is a specialized motion-generation model rather than LLM inference.

records.title: 3D-Mix for VLA: A Plug-and-Play Module for Integrating VGGT-based 3D Information into Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: The paper adds VGGT-based 3D feature fusion to VLA robot controllers and reports success-rate gains. Its abstract and method do not claim an inference-path change or runtime efficiency; the linked TinyVLA relation is only an application-area overlap.

records.title: Chameleon: Control-Indexed Prospective Memory for Visuomotor Manipulation
records.reason: arXiv abstract: prospective memory for visuomotor control improves manipulation success; it is a robot policy, not an LLM inference/runtime improvement.

records.title: Cognitive Mismatch in Multimodal Large Language Models for Discrete Symbol Understanding
records.reason: arXiv abstract: benchmarks discrete-symbol understanding failures in MLLMs; it introduces an evaluation set, not an inference optimization.
